$comment: Descriptive, derived from the types the bounded parser reads; the parser is the only authority on validity. Where the parser reads two versions of a document with one type, this schema admits what that type admits, including members the later version adds. Byte, depth and count bounds are recorded in x-rustev-parse-limits (a string length here counts characters, the parser counts bytes), and rules applied when a plan is compiled are stated in field descriptions, not enforced here.

oneOf.description: Softmax with max subtraction in declared option order.

OutputKind.description: What a backend returns for an operation (design section 8.2).

RequiredKind.description: The value kind a semantic step requires (spec 002, 3.9.3).

Scope.description: The isolation scope of a capture, a bundle and every request identity.

oneOf.description:
Reuse across principals within one tenant and context revision: an
explicit host assertion that the computation is principal-independent
and that the host authorizes every reader (spec 004, 3.1.4).

Reuse only within one tenant, context revision and effective
principal scope. The default.

backend_id.description: The actual target's backend: the primary or an explicit fallback.

projection.description:
The exact canonical projection bytes, which are UTF-8 JSON: operation,
task, question, ordered options, candidates, instance and values.
